title: When a glowing UFO outmaneuvered a Pan Adria Airliner and MiG-21 Interceptors
title_norm: when a glowing ufo outmaneuvered a pan adria airliner and mig 21 interceptors
snippet: The Pan Adria Incident is one of the most famous UFO cases from the former Yugoslavia. It reportedly occurred on 16 August 1977, when a Pan Adria Airways aircraft flying the route Zagreb → Belgrade → Titograd (now Podgorica) encountered a mysterious glowing object that allegedly remained alongside…
